error.VALIDATION_FAILED: {n} fields need fixing – see the red note under each field.
error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again – what you typed is kept on this device.
error.FORBIDDEN_ACTION: Your account can't do this. Ask a manager if needed.
error.NOT_FOUND: This item wasn't found or you can't view it. Reload the list.
error.ROOM_UNAVAILABLE: Room {room} is taken from {from} to {to}. Choose other dates or a free room below.
error.ROOM_BLOCKED: Room {room} is out of order from {from} to {to}. Choose another room.
error.ROOM_NOT_SELLABLE: Room {room} isn't for sale right now. Choose another room.
error.INVALID_TRANSITION: This booking just changed to "{status}", so this action no longer applies. Reload to see what you can do now.
error.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else just changed this. Reload to see the latest – what you typed is kept.
error.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: Please reload before saving. Tap Reload – what you typed is kept.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This action was already sent with different details. Reload and try again.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: Your previous action is still being processed. Wait a few seconds – no need to tap again.
error.HOLD_EXPIRED: The hold expired at {time} and the room is back on sale. Create a new hold if it's still free.
error.HOLD_NOT_ALLOWED_TODAY: You can't hold a room for a same-day arrival. Take payment and create the booking now.
error.QUOTE_EXPIRED: This quote has expired. Ask a manager to extend it, or make a new quote at current rates.
error.CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Room {room} sleeps up to {max}. Reduce guests or choose a larger room.
error.OUTSIDE_BOOKING_WINDOW: The arrival date or number of nights is outside the bookable range. Pick other dates, or make a long-stay quote.
error.RATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Rate must be between {min} and {max} (floor – ceiling for {group}).
error.PHONE_REQUIRED: Direct and agent bookings need the guest's phone number.
error.DEPOSIT_INSUFFICIENT: Deposit not enough: {required} needed, {paid} recorded. Record the rest, then confirm.
error.CHECKIN_CONDITIONS_NOT_MET: Can't check in yet: {unmet}. Resolve the missing items in the conditions list.

error.BALANCE_DUE: {amount} not yet recorded as paid. Record full payment before completing (or a manager records it as receivable).
error.PENDING_APPROVALS: {n} waiver/discount requests are still awaiting approval. Wait for approval or withdraw them, then complete.
error.FOLIO_LOCKED: The folio is locked after check-out. Only a manager can post an adjustment.

error.APPROVAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The amount is above your approval limit. The request has gone to {approver}.
error.DUPLICATE_GUEST: This phone/email belongs to {guest}. Use that profile?
error.CARD_NUMBER_DETECTED: The note contains what looks like a card number. Remove it – OTTIMO doesn't store card numbers.
error.PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: No receiving account is set up, so VietQR can't be created. Choose another method and ask the owner to set it up.
error.REGISTRATION_INCOMPLETE: Registration incomplete: IDs missing or warnings without a note.
error.GUEST_LINK_INVALID: This link has expired or is no longer valid. Message OTTIMO for a new one.
error.GUEST_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: To see this, verify with the code sent by email or given by reception.
error.DEVICE_NOT_TRUSTED: This device isn't approved for IDs and door codes. Use an approved desk computer, or ask the owner to approve this one.
error.FILE_REJECTED: This file can't be used. Only JPG, PNG, HEIC or PDF of reasonable size – retake or choose another file.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
error.server: The server is having a problem. Nothing has been lost. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, give your manager the reference {request_id}.
extend.title: Extend stay · Room {room} · {guest}

noshow.reminder: {guest} hasn't arrived for room {room}. Call or message, then record the result.
noshow.locked: Available from {time} once a contact result is recorded.
noshow.title: Mark {guest} as no-show?

noshow.consequence_ota: Room {room} goes back on sale {from} → {to}. A task "Report no-show on {channel}" is created so the channel doesn't charge commission.
noshow.restore_body: The guest has arrived. Room {room} is taken off sale again from {from}. Only possible within the arrival night's business day.
noshow.restore_request_sent: Restore request sent to a manager.
confirm.cancel_booking.title: Cancel booking {code} for {guest}?
confirm.cancel_booking.body: Room {room} goes back on sale {from} → {to} on all channels. {retained} kept (cancellation fee); {refund} refunded – needs manager approval.
confirm.channel_close.title: Close room {room} on {channel}?
confirm.channel_close.body: Guests won't be able to book room {room} on {channel} from {from} to {to}. Existing bookings stay.
confirm.channel_open.title: Open room {room} on {channel}?
confirm.channel_open.body: Room {room} will accept bookings on {channel} from {from} to {to} at current rates.
confirm.merge_guest.title: Merge profile {a} into {b}?
confirm.merge_guest.body: {a}'s stays, tags and bookings move to {b}. The old code {old_code} still resolves. This can't be undone.
confirm.wo_done.title: Close {wo} and unblock room {room}?
confirm.wo_done.body: Room {room} becomes "Vacant dirty" and goes back on sale from today on all channels.
confirm.purge_images.title: Delete {guest}'s ID photos now?
confirm.purge_images.body: The photos are permanently deleted and can't be recovered. Registration details are kept as required by law.
hk.self_inspect_help: Needs the full checklist and room photos.
hk.lock_by_others: Reception or maintenance will decide whether to block the room.
hk.lock_request: Block room – no sales until fixed

auth.totp.help: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown.
auth.totp.error: The code is wrong or has changed. Enter the code currently shown in the app.
auth.totp.recovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
device.title: Approved devices
device.this_untrusted: This device isn't approved for ID data and door codes.
device.grant_confirm: Re-enter your password (and authentication code) to approve
device.grant_checklist: Disk encrypted, screen locks after 5 minutes, no browser extensions, clipboard history/sync off
device.revoke_body: {device} immediately loses access to IDs and door codes. It must be approved again to use them.
device.blocked_body: IDs and door codes only open on an approved desk computer. Everything else (bookings, check-out, housekeeping) still works here.
device.pwa_note: IDs and door codes aren't available on phones. Use the desk computer.
desk_code.body: Read this code to the guest at the desk or call the phone on the booking. Single use, expires in 10 minutes.
desk_code.warning: Don't send the code by chat together with the guest link.
guest.offline_banner: You're offline. You can still see what's loaded; send requests when you're back online.
guest.oci.upload_weak: Weak connection – the photo was compressed and will retry automatically.
guest.req.decline.fully_booked: Fully booked for the time you chose
guest.req.decline.other: Other reason – reception will message you
guest.lang.ru_soon: Russian version coming soon – showing English for now.
guest.late.title: Arriving late? Self check-in
guest.late.prompt: Arriving after 22:00? Complete online check-in now to get your door code before you arrive – no need to wait for reception.
guest.late.arrival_hint: You'll arrive after 22:00: once check-in is done you'll get your door code and can go straight to your room.
guest.late.done_title: All set! Your door code is ready
guest.late.code_kept: The code stays available in this session: reopen this page to see it, even with a weak connection. If you close the browser you'll need to verify again.
guest.late.no_share: Please don't share a screenshot of this code.
guest.late.how_1: Go to room {room} and touch the lock keypad to wake it.
guest.late.how_3: Green light: push the door. Red light: wait 5 seconds and try again.
guest.contact.title: Need help? Night staff
guest.verify.locked_help: Can't open your door code? Call or message the night staff – they'll give you a verification code.
guest.verify.no_email: Your booking has no email. Call or message reception to get a code.
guest.late.not_ready: Haven't checked in online? You can still check in: call the night staff when you arrive and they'll do it for you on an OTTIMO device.
booking.email_help: Optional. With an email the guest can get their own code to see the door code and bill.
booking.no_email_warn: No email on this booking – the guest will need a code from reception.
desk_code.channel_off: Sending by message is off. The owner can turn it on in Settings › Code channels.
desk_code.separate: The code is sent as a separate message, without the guest link.
night.device_note: Night shift works on an approved OTTIMO device (desk computer or OTTIMO tablet) using the admin site – not on personal phones.
auth.login.error_generic: Incorrect username or password. Forgot it? Ask the owner to reset it.
auth.code_label.totp: Code from your authenticator app (6 digits)
auth.enroll.title: Turn on 2-step verification
auth.enroll.step1_help: Install a free authenticator app on your phone, e.g. Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
auth.enroll.step2_help: In the app, choose Add account → Scan QR code, then scan the code below.
auth.enroll.confirm: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm
auth.enroll.step3_help: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe (printed or in a password manager); don't send them by chat.
auth.enroll.ack: I've saved my 10 recovery codes somewhere safe
auth.enroll.single_owner: You're the only owner. If you lose both your phone and recovery codes, the tech team must unlock your account (this takes time). Consider adding a recovery person.

msg.utility_bill: Hi {name}, your utilities bill for {period}: electricity {kwh} kWh, water {m3} m³, total {amount}, due {due}. Meter photos and details: {link}
